_comment: Cross-language golden fixtures for classifier context serialization (contract v2). Python: framework/context.py + tests/test_context.py. Java: ConversationThreadRenderer (+ ContentExtractor.partPlaceholder) MUST reproduce these byte-for-byte (ConversationThreadContractParityTest) — this file IS train/serve parity. contract_v2 pins per-turn rendering (render_context/render_input): user verbatim, assistant capped at 256 tokens (head + '…[+N tok]'), tool_call/tool_result parts enriched to terse markers ([tool:<name> ok] / [tool:<name> error: <=120-char snippet]; a successful tool_result collapses to nothing), image/file/unsupported placeholders unchanged. reduction pins reduce_thread: standalone tool-observation markers, error snippets, the assistant cap, and trajectory-preserving eviction (keep head + earliest failure + most-recent recent_k, thin the middle, mark drops '[… N earlier turns elided …]', never drop the scored final). Do not edit rendered strings without bumping the contract version everywhere. The `narrowing` cases pin windowByUserTurns/stubAssistants (the pooled-head context policy).
